title: Additivity of the discrete derivative
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $i$ be a coordinate of the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $f,g$ be real-valued functions on that cube. The discrete derivative in coordinate $i$ of $f+g$ equals the sum of the discrete derivatives of $f$ and $g$.
